title: Simulator MCP draft tool contract
description: Application-level tool arguments and result payloads. x-tools identifies schemas to register after resolving local references. Runtime validation also checks discovered ROS-Z schemas and cross-field constraints described in the design.

Nanoseconds.description: Decimal nanoseconds; simulation receipt time is elapsed from this session's clock origin. Wall time is Unix epoch time. Source time preserves the publisher's clock.

topic.description: Relative to target namespace, or an absolute topic inside the target's scope.

path.description: ROS-Z ValuePath; empty selects the entire payload.

local_path.description: Absolute path on the local MCP server host.

read_uri_template.description: Read this resource URI with a byte offset and a length of at most 1048576. Concatenate decoded bytes before parsing UTF-8.

result.description: On success, validates against the originating tool's x-tools completion_schema.

competition.description: Value advertised by server_info; validated against chosen field and player counts.

preset.description: Arms trace, status and timing subscriptions. Keep the observation until diagnostics are no longer needed.

Verification.description: Evidence for selected rows. Interior sequence gaps and MCP-observed parameter revisions do not prove complete delivery or a full parameter change history.

x-tools.name: server_info
x-tools.description: Describe supported simulator configurations, input schemas, query budgets and rendering availability.

x-tools.name: simulator_start
x-tools.description: Start one isolated headless simulator, initially paused.

x-tools.name: simulator_status
x-tools.description: Inspect session lifecycle, clocks, readiness and targets.

x-tools.name: simulator_control
x-tools.description: Control physics execution. Advance starts and ends paused; stop finalizes recordings.

x-tools.name: scene_read
x-tools.description: Read an atomic physics snapshot with stable entity identities.

x-tools.name: scene_edit
x-tools.description: Apply one scene edit while paused, guarded by scene revision.

x-tools.name: simulator_input
x-tools.description: Operate simulator inputs. Referee/controller arguments follow schemas advertised by server_info.

x-tools.name: rosz_graph
x-tools.description: Discover nodes and endpoints in a target's transport scope.

x-tools.name: rosz_schema
x-tools.description: Get discovered types and canonical JSON schemas for topics, services or node parameters.

x-tools.name: rosz_observe
x-tools.description: Create persistent observations for selected topics and fields.

x-tools.name: rosz_read
x-tools.description: Read latest data or retained history. Historical reads can opt into recording fallback without an observation handle.

x-tools.name: rosz_unobserve
x-tools.description: Release an observation and its retained data when no other handle owns it.

x-tools.name: rosz_wait
x-tools.description: Wait for a fresh observed condition without advancing simulation time.

x-tools.name: rosz_parameter_read
x-tools.description: Read effective parameters and revision/layer metadata.

x-tools.name: rosz_parameter_write
x-tools.description: Write parameters with node-side validation. A set batch is atomic within one node.

x-tools.name: rosz_publish
x-tools.description: Publish a schema-validated payload once or for a bounded interval.

x-tools.name: rosz_call
x-tools.description: Call a discovered service with its request schema and an explicit wall timeout.

x-tools.name: logs_read
x-tools.description: Read filtered structured logs through the log history service and live topic.

x-tools.name: view_render
x-tools.description: Render an on-demand scene, plot, map or published image with data provenance.

x-tools.name: video_capture
x-tools.description: Arm a bounded future scene capture. It does not advance simulation time.

x-tools.name: operation_status
x-tools.description: Read an operation, optionally waiting for up to 30 wall-clock seconds.

x-tools.name: operation_cancel
x-tools.description: Request cancellation and report the operation's current effect status.

x-tools.name: query_release
x-tools.description: Release an unfinished query snapshot or its last-page retry response. Releasing an absent query succeeds with zero freed bytes.

x-tools.name: rosz_export
x-tools.description: Stream a historical interval to JSONL or CSV plus verification metadata. Select retained observations by default, or explicitly select an immutable recording checkpoint. Does not allocate pagination snapshots. Rows preserve collector order rather than global time order.
